properties.name: alignment
hand: written configures the strip and invalidates
properties.comment: The edge the tabs sit on (Windows Forms' Alignment; default top). An unknown alignment throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: appearance
hand: written repaints the strip as well
properties.comment: How the tabs are drawn (see TabAppearance; default normal). An unknown appearance throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: size_mode
hand: written configures the strip and invalidates
properties.comment: How wide each tab is (see TabSizeMode; default normal). An unknown mode throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: item_size
hand: written configures the strip and invalidates
properties.comment: A tab's size: its height across the row, and its width along it in TabSizeMode::fixed (default 120 by 30). A size that is not finite, under 24 by 18 or over 1024 by 1024 throws std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: image_list
hand: prepare hands the list to the strip, which checks it first, so a refused list changes neither
written moves the change subscription and invalidates
properties.comment: The images the pages' image_key and image_index name (Windows Forms' ImageList), or null; a tab shows its image before its text. A disposed list or one belonging to another window throws std::invalid_argument and keeps the old list.

properties.name: draw_mode
hand: a view onto the strip's draw_mode
properties.comment: Content-only owner drawing of the tabs (owner decision W-Q6; Windows Forms' DrawMode with DrawItem), the strip's: in ItemDrawMode::owner_draw draw_item_content is raised for each painted tab's icon and label, with the tab's index and its page's stable ID; the tab's plate and focus cue stay painted by role. See PageStrip::draw_item_content.
